blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Vision--language models (VLMs) are tested for fine-grained understanding with image--text matching probes, a model must prefer the correct image or caption over handcrafted negative. In retrieval, the correct item must beat thousands of alternatives. We measure how these two evaluation methods relate by using two probing benchmarks, \svo{} and SugarCrepe, for retrieval tasks. For 100 image and caption queries we judge the top-10 retrievals from full dataset of six VLMs, with human annotators and an LLM assessor. We than compare how well models rank pool of items on the same queries, while changing only where the negatives comes from: the benchmark, a random draw, or the judged-incorrect retrievals of other models. On \svo{} the accuracy of retrieving a positive over handcrafted negatives is significantly higher than for retrieved ones (the correct item is preferred in 85\% against 77\% of the time). Using pool of ten retrieved negatives leads to same accuracy as when one uses pool of 200 to 430 random negatives. On SugarCrepe the order is reversed: its handcrafted negatives are harder than the retrieved ones. Incomplete relevance labels explain most of the low retrieval scores on \svo{}, where the top-ranked item is correct for 54--90\% of the queries under human labels against 6--21\% under the benchmark's labels. However, we detect no association between passing the probe for a query and retrieving a correct item first. The LLM assessor o3 agrees with individual annotators ($κ$ 0.57--0.61) slightly less than they agree with each other (0.64--0.68).
blocks.zh: 视觉-语言模型(VLMs)通过图像-文字匹配探测器进行精细的理解测试,一个模型必须选择正确的图像或标题而不是手动的负. 在取回时,正确的物品必须战胜上千种替代品. 我们通过使用两个测试基准,\svo{}和SugarCrepe来衡量这两种评估方法之间的关系。 对于100个图像和字幕查询,我们从6个VLM的完整数据集中判断出10个最高检索率,并配有人类注释员和一个LLM评估员. 我们比比较模型在相同的查询上排列项目库的级别好得多,而只改变负数的来源:基准、随机抽取或其他模型的判断不正确检索。 在\svo{}上,取出正反手动底片的准确性明显高于取回底片的准确性(正确的项目在85\%对时间的77\%). 使用10个检索到的底片池,与使用200至430个随机底片池一样准确。 在SugarCrepe上,订单被反转:其手动底片比取回的底片更难. 不完整的关联性标签解释了\svoQQ上大多数低检索分数,其中排行榜上的项目在人类标签下54-90QQ对基准标签下6-21QQ的查询是正确的. 然而,我们发现,通过探测器进行查询与首先取回正确物品之间没有任何关联。 LLM评估员o3同意个别注释员(0.57-0.61美元)的意见,略低于他们彼此之间的一致意见(0.64-0.68)。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Fine-grained understanding in vision–language models (VLMs) is usually measured with image–text matching (ITM) probes or with similar visual question answering (VQA) tasks. Benchmarks such as SVO-Probes [ 12 ] , VALSE [ 30 ] , Winoground [ 39 ] or SugarCrepe [ 14 ] take a correct image–caption pair, add handcrafted negatives that differ in a single semantic component, and report how often the model prefers the correct pair. Probes are cheap to run and easy to interpret, since each negative isolates one phenomenon, and progress on them is read as progress in fine-grained understanding [ 5 , 20 ] .
blocks.zh: 视觉-语言模型(VLM)中的精细理解通常用图像-文本匹配(ITM)探测器或相类似的视觉问答(VQA)任务来测量. SVO-Probes [12],VALSE [30],Winoground [39] 或SugarCrepe [14] 等基准,取正确图像-封装对,添加单个语义成分相异的手动底片,并报告模型多常偏爱正确的对子. 探测器运行成本低廉,易被解读,因为每个负数都孤立出一种现象,而对于这些现象的进步被解读为在精细理解上的进步[5,20].

blocks.en: That reading assumes that a probe predicts how the model behaves where fine-grained understanding matters. For dual encoders the main such setting is retrieval. It requires the correct item to be ranked above thousands of alternatives, and the most challenging are the items closest to the correct one in the model’s own representation space, not necessarily the ones a benchmark designer chose ( Figure 1 ). In information retrieval terms, an ITM probe is a ranking evaluation with a candidate set of size two and a fixed distribution of distractors. Whether that distribution resembles the distractors a model meets in retrieval is an open question, and the usual way of answering it, comparing probe accuracy with Recall@1 on a retrieval benchmark, proves little: a two-way choice and a many-way ranking have different chance levels, and relevance labels are incomplete, so a retrieved item that is correct but unlabelled counts as an error.
blocks.zh: 这种读取假设一个探测器预测模型如何在精细的理解很重要的地方表现. 对于双重编码器,主要设置是检索。 它要求正确的项目排序在数千种替代品之上,最有挑战性的项目是模型自己代表空间中最接近正确项目的项目,不一定是基准设计者选择的项目(图1)。 在信息检索方面,ITM探测器是一种排名评价,其候选量为2个大小,分心器固定分布. 这种分布是否类似于一个模式在检索中遇到的分心者是一个未解的问题,通常的回答方式,在检索基准上将探针精度与Recall@1进行比较,证明的很少:双向选择和多向排名的机会水平不同,关联性标签不完整,因此一个被检索的,正确但无标签的计数为出错.

blocks.zh: 图1:来自SVO-Probes的字幕查询. 所有六个模型都得正(a)分高于手动负(b)分,其中对象被改变. 图像(c)在前10名中被检索,但被判定不正确,但有5个模型将其评分高于正数。

blocks.en: Prior work has approached the two sides separately. One line focuses on making negatives harder for probing, by filtering them [ 14 ] or by adding negative images [ 28 , 2 ] or mine natural adversarial examples for new benchmarks [ 40 , 21 ] . Second focuses on retrieval, for example re-judges collections to remove false negatives [ 6 , 31 ] . None of them puts the handcrafted negatives of a probe next to the negatives that retrieval actually produces for the same query, and none asks whether passing the probe says anything about retrieval for the query.
blocks.zh: 以前的工作已分别接近双方。 一行侧重于通过过滤[14]或增加负面图像[28,2]或为新的基准增加地雷自然对抗性实例,使底片更难于探测。 第二个重点是检索,例如重新判断收藏,去除虚假的负数[6,31]. 没有一个将探测器的手动底片放入实际为同一查询而生成的底片旁边,也没有人问通过探测器是否对查询的检索有任何说明.

blocks.en: We do this for two probing benchmarks, SVO-Probes and SugarCrepe over COCO, which we treat as retrieval tasks for six VLMs. For every benchmark we build a judged pool : for 100 image and caption queries, the top-10 retrievals of every model are labelled as correct or incorrect by human annotators and/or LLM assessor o3. The pools allow a controlled experiment. We fix the query and the decision, “does the positive score above the negative?”, and change only where the negative comes from: the benchmark’s handcrafted negatives, random items of the dataset, or judged-incorrect items retrieved by other models or by itself. We ask (RQ1) how hard handcrafted negatives are compared with retrieval-mined ones, (RQ2) how much of the gap between probe accuracy and retrieval success is due to incomplete labels, (RQ3) whether passing the probe for a query predicts a correct first retrieval for the same query, and (RQ4) whether an LLM assessor can stand in for the human judges that such pools require.
blocks.zh: 我们这样做是为了两个测试基准, SVO-Probes 和 SugarCrepe over CO, 我们把它当作六个VLM的检索任务. 对于每个基准,我们构建一个判断的集合:对于100个图像和标题查询,人类注释者和(或)LLM评估者o3将每个模型的上-10检索标为正确或不正确。 池子允许进行受控实验. 我们处理询问和决定,“在负数之上做正分吗?” , 并只在负数来自以下情况时才改变:基准的手动负数、数据集的随机项目,或由其他模型或自己检索的判断不正确项目。 我们询问(RQ1)如何将硬手动底片与被取回的底片进行比较,(RQ2)探针精度与取回成功之间有多少差距是由于标签不全造成的,(RQ3)通过取取取查询的探针是否预测同一取取取的正确第一取取取,以及(RQ4)LLM评估员是否能够代表这种集合所需要的人类裁判.

blocks.en:
(i) A controlled comparison of handcrafted and retrieval-mined negatives on two benchmarks. On SVO-Probes the handcrafted negatives are significantly easier than judged-incorrect items retrieved by other models; the difference survives restricting the mined negatives to those rejected by all three annotators or by a second assessor, and it grows for shallower pools. On SugarCrepe the handcrafted negatives are the harder ones. How a probe compares with retrieval is thus a property of the individual benchmark and has to be measured.
(ii) Judged top-10 pools for both benchmarks, with human labels on SVO-Probes, together with metric definitions, annotation instructions and a pipeline that applies to any probing benchmark. 1 1 1 https://anonymous.4open.science/r/probe-retrieval-supplementary-4CC4 (iii) Evidence on what the probe and the strict retrieval metric each miss: incomplete labels explain most but not all of the low Success@1, no association is detected between passing the probe for a query and retrieving a correct item first, and an LLM assessor agrees with individual annotators slightly less than they agree with each other.
blocks.zh:
(一) 在两个基准上对手动和取回的负数进行有控制的比较。 在SVO-Probes上,手工制成的底片比其他模型取回的判断不正确物品要容易得多;这种差别继续存在,将所开采的底片限制在所有三个注释者或第二个评估者所拒绝的底片上,它生长在更浅的池中。 在"糖浆"上,手工制成的底片是最难的. 因此,探测器如何与检索相比,是单个基准的属性,必须加以衡量。
(二) 对两个基准的顶级10个集合进行评分,在SVO-Probes上标出人类的标签,并加上适用于任何测试基准的计量定义、注释说明和管道。 (三)关于探测器和严格的检索尺度每差一分的证据:不完全的标签可以解释大多数但并非全部的低成功@1,在通过探测器进行查询和首先取回正确物品之间没有发现任何关联,一个LLM评估员对个别注释员的同意略低于他们彼此同意的程度.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Foiling [ 35 ] set the recipe: take a correct image–caption pair and build a negative that differs in one controlled aspect. SVO-Probes [ 12 ] varies the subject, verb or object; VALSE [ 30 ] , VSR [ 26 ] , VL-CheckList [ 47 ] , CV-Probes [ 4 ] and ViLMA [ 19 ] cover other phenomena; Winoground [ 39 ] , CREPE [ 27 ] and ARO [ 45 ] target compositionality. Later work repaired the negatives: SugarCrepe [ 14 ] removed those detectable from text alone, and others added negative images [ 28 , 2 , 46 ] . CREPE [ 27 ] and ARO [ 45 ] phrase compositionality as retrieval, but over small candidate sets of generated hard negatives with no human check. All of these evaluate a decision on negatives fixed in advance by their designers, as do the expert-written contrast sets of Gardner et al. [ 10 ] ; we keep those as one condition and add negatives mined by retrievers over the same dataset and verified by an assessor.
blocks.zh: Foing [35] 设置了配方: 取一个正确的图像 - 封装对并构建一个在控制的一个方面不同的负. SVO-Probes [12] 不同主体,动词或对象;VALSE [30],VSR [26],VL-CheckList [47],CV-Probes [4]和ViLMA [19] 涵盖其他现象;Winoground [39],CREPE [27]和ARO [45]目标成分. 后作修复了底片:SugarCrepe [14] 从文本中单独去除了可探测到的,而有的则添加了底片图像[28,2,46]. CREPE [27]和ARO [45] 短语的成分性作为检索,但超过了小套候选生成的硬底片,没有人检查. 所有这些都评价了由设计者预先确定的关于负数的决定,Gardner等人的专家写作的对照组也是如此。 [10];我们保留这些作为一个条件,并增加由检索者在同一数据集上开采的由评估者核实的底片.

blocks.en: Image–text retrieval is scored against annotated matches per item although many retrieved items are correct but unlabelled [ 15 ] . Crisscrossed Captions [ 31 ] and ECCV Caption [ 6 ] added human judgments for unlabelled MS-COCO [ 25 ] pairs, the latter by pooling models and verifying candidates as in IR test-collection practice [ 48 , 43 ] . We apply depth-10 pooling to a probing benchmark and use the pool as ground truth for a controlled experiment, not only as a metric correction.
blocks.zh: 图像 - 文本检索按每件附加说明的匹配进行打分, 尽管许多检索的项目正确但无标签 [15] 。 Crisscrossed Caption [31]和ECCV Caption [6] 增加了对无标签的MS-COCO[25]对子的人类判断,后者通过集合模型和核查候选人,如IR测试-收集实践[48,43]. 我们把深度-10集合到一个测试基准上, 并且把池子用作受控实验的地上真理, 不仅仅是作为度量校正。

blocks.en: Hard negatives mined from a model’s own scores are central to contrastive training [ 23 , 34 , 45 ] and to dense retrieval [ 18 ] , where unlabelled positives among the mined items are a known problem [ 32 ] ; MMVP [ 40 ] and NaturalBench [ 21 ] mine natural adversarial examples with models to build harder benchmarks. We use mining for evaluation over the probe’s own dataset, with an assessor’s label on every mined negative. LLMs are increasingly used to produce relevance labels [ 9 , 38 , 42 , 11 ] , with known failure modes [ 1 ] and a live debate on whether they can stand in for human assessors at all [ 37 , 7 ] . Multimodal assessors have been validated for ad hoc image search [ 44 ] and product search [ 13 ] ; we validate two of them for a fine-grained matching task against a majority vote and against individual annotators.
blocks.zh: 从模型本身的分数中挖掘出硬负数是对比性训练[23、34、45]和密集取回[18]的核心,在这些被埋物品中未加标记的正数是一个已知的问题[32];MMVP[40]和Natural Bench[21]地雷天然对抗性例子,其模型可以建立更硬的基准。 我们利用采矿来评估探测器自己的数据集, LLMs越来越多地被用来制作相关的标签[9,38,42,11],已知的失败模式[1],并现场辩论它们是否能够站出来供人类评审[37,7]. 为临时图像搜索[44]和产品搜索[13],验证了多式联运评估员;我们验证了其中两人对多数投票和个别注释员的精细匹配任务。

blocks.en: 3 Probing Benchmarks as Retrieval Tasks
blocks.zh: 3 作为检索任务的测试基准

blocks.en: SVO-Probes [ 12 ] consists of triplets ⟨ \langle caption, positive image, negative image ⟩ \rangle whose negative image shows a scene that differs from the caption’s ⟨ s ​ u ​ b ​ j ​ e ​ c ​ t , v ​ e ​ r ​ b , o ​ b ​ j ​ e ​ c ​ t ⟩ \langle subject,verb,object\rangle triplet in exactly one role. Our copy has 33,685 triplets over 10,978 captions and 13,285 images, of which 11,455 are the positive image of at least one caption and serve as image queries. SugarCrepe [ 14 ] provides 7,511 items over 1,560 images of COCO val2017 [ 25 ] , each an image with one of its captions and a fluent negative caption that adds, replaces or swaps an object, an attribute or a relation. The retrieval dataset is all 5,000 val2017 images and their 24,789 distinct captions. In both benchmarks the images are the candidates for text-to-image retrieval (T → \rightarrow I) and the captions the candidates for image-to-text retrieval (I → \rightarrow T). The relevant set R ⁡ ( q ) R(q) of a query is given by the benchmark: the positive images of a caption, or the captions of an image. Success@ K K is the share of queries with an item of R ⁡ ( q ) R(q) in the top K K . Pairwise accuracy is the share of probe items in which the positive pair scores above the negative one. The handcrafted negatives of a caption query on SVO-Probes are the negative images of its triplets, and those of an image query are the captions of the negative images of its triplets. SugarCrepe’s negatives are captions, so its probe is image-to-text only and its handcrafted negatives exist for image queries only.

blocks.en: We evaluate six models. Four are used zero-shot as dual encoders: CLIP ViT-L/14 [ 33 ] , FLAVA [ 36 ] , SigLIP2 base [ 41 ] and the first-stage BLIP-2 Q-Former [ 22 ] . For BLIP-2 we use the embedding of the first query token without ITM re-ranking, a reduced variant of the published retrieval setting, which takes the maximum over all 32 query tokens and re-ranks with the matching head. The other two models are built on generative Qwen VLMs. Qwen2.5-VL-FT is our own light adaptation of Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct [ 3 ] : image and caption are each wrapped in a prompt asking the model to express the input “in one word” [ 16 , 17 ] , the last hidden state is the embedding, and a QLoRA adapter [ 8 ] is trained contrastively on 10,000 MS-COCO training pairs for one epoch. Qwen3-VL-Embed [ 24 ] is a purpose-built embedding model with 2B parameters, used zero-shot. Retrieval and pairwise scores are cosine similarities of the image and caption embeddings, except that on SVO-Probes CLIP, FLAVA and SigLIP2 are scored with the dot product of their unnormalised embeddings, the rule under which their judged lists were produced ( Section 5 ). Checkpoints and prompts are listed in the repository.

blocks.en: The pool queries are 100 caption–image pairs sampled at random: the captions are the caption queries and their positive images the image queries. For each query we retrieved the top 10 candidates of every model: 3,714 unique pairs in each direction on SVO-Probes, and 3,071 and 3,491 on COCO. A pair is labelled correct when the caption could describe the image fully and incorrect when its subject, verb or object does not match the image; an incorrect pair carries the error type. Every model’s list is labelled separately and blind to the model that produced it. On SVO-Probes, the I → \rightarrow T lists of CLIP, BLIP-2, FLAVA and SigLIP2 were labelled by three annotators (an expert-author, and two volunteers; all have tertiary education, are non-native speakers of English and followed the written instructions that we release) and decided by majority vote; all other SVO-Probes lists, including the I → \rightarrow T lists of the two Qwen models, were labelled by the expert alone. A pair retrieved by several models was labelled once per list. All SVO-Probes lists were also labelled by the LLM assessor o3. On COCO, the pool was labelled by o3, and the expert labelled a subset to validate it on this benchmark. Agreement between the annotators and with the assessor is reported in Section 6 .

blocks.en: 4 Retrieval-Mined Contrast Sets

blocks.en: 5 Results
blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.en: Table 1 and Table 2 confirm the picture that motivated this work. Pairwise accuracy on SVO-Probes is close to 100%, with object negatives the easiest and verb negatives the hardest, whereas strict Success@1 over the full dataset is very low for caption and also image queries. On the 100 pool queries the top-ranked item is correct under the human labels for 54–90%, against a strict Success@1 of 6–21% on the same queries. Incomplete labels thus explain most of the low strict scores, but for 10 to 46% of the queries the top-ranked item is wrong under human labels too. Whether the probe orders the models as retrieval does cannot be settled with six models. Qwen3-VL-Embed is first on the probe and on full-dataset and human-judged Success@1, and Kendall’s τ \tau between pairwise accuracy and human-judged Success@1 is 0.60 in both directions ( p = 0.14 p=0.14 ). The clearest disagreement concerns FLAVA and SigLIP2, which are level on the probe, but for image queries the top-ranked caption of SigLIP2 is correct 16 points more often than that of FLAVA ( p = 0.007 p=0.007 , paired randomisation test), whereas for caption queries, the difference is 3 points and not significant.
blocks.zh: 表1和表2证实了推动这项工作的情况。 SVO-Probes上的对等精确度接近100%,对象负数最简单,动词负数最难,而完整数据集上的严格成功@1对于标题和图像查询都非常低. 在100个游泳池的查询中,排名最高的项目在人类标签下为54-90%正确,而在相同的查询中则严格成功@1为6-21%。 不完全的标签因此解释了大多数低严格分数,但对于10到46%的查询,排名最高的项目在人类标签下也是错误的. 探测器是否像检索一样命令模型,不能用6个模型解决. Qune3-VL-Embed在探测器和全数据集及人判断成功@1上首发;而肯德尔在对等精度与人判断成功@1之间的tau双向0.60(p=0.14 p=0.14). 最明显的分歧涉及FLAVA和SigLIP2,它们位于探测器上平面,但对于图像查询,SigLIP2的排名最高的字幕是正确的,比FLAVA更频繁地出现16分(p=0.007p=0.007,配对随机化测试),而对于标题查询,相差3分,并不显著.

blocks.en: Pairwise accuracy on SugarCrepe is lower than for SVO-Probes, as the dataset negatives were filtered, with object edits the easiest and attribute and relation edits the hardest. Success@1 is far higher than on SVO-Probes, because every image has five relevant captions and the dataset has about a third as many images. Every pool-based number for SugarCrepe rests on the o3 labels validated in Section 6 , not on human labels. The retrieval numbers of the two Qwen models are in-domain here: Qwen2.5-VL-FT was adapted on COCO training pairs and the training mix of Qwen3-VL-Embed is likely to include COCO. Under the o3 labels the top-ranked item is correct for 40–93% of the pool queries, against a strict 22–69%. Kendall’s τ \tau between pairwise accuracy and Success@1 is 0.87 for caption and 0.47 for image queries ( p = 0.02 p=0.02 and 0.27 0.27 , uncorrected), which six models again cannot settle.

blocks.en: The upper half of Table 3 contains the central results for SVO-Probes. It presents the share of negatives scored below the best relevant item by origin of negatives. Random items of the dataset are almost never preferred over the positive. The handcrafted negatives, which differ in one role, are 4 to 13 points harder. Judged negatives mined from the top-10 lists of other models are harder again, by a further 6 to 11 points, and this difference is significant for every model in both directions. The other-mined condition contains only items the model never ranked in its top 10, so a negative there can outrank the positive only when the positive itself is outside the top 10, which is the case for 40 to 72 of the 100 queries. On those queries the positive beats the handcrafted negatives 79–91% of the time and the other-mined ones 63–74%, a gap of 10 to 21 points ( p < 0.05 p<0.05 in all cells). The model’s own top-10 errors are scored below the positive only 23–40% of the time in T → \rightarrow I and 19–46% in I → \rightarrow T. This condition is circular by construction ( Section 4 ).

blocks.en: The lower half of Table 3 repeats the matched-negative comparison under the o3 labels for Sugar Crepe. In I → \rightarrow T, the direction that has handcrafted negatives, SugarCrepe’s negatives are harder than the other-mined negatives for every model and lie within 5 points of all pooled negatives. These values exceed the probe accuracy of Table 1 because every condition scores a negative against the best relevant item and a COCO image has five relevant captions; on SVO-Probes, where most queries have one relevant item, the two rules differ by at most 1.3 points. The order is the same under the probe’s own rule, with every negative scored against the caption from which the SugarCrepe item was built. Accuracy on the handcrafted negatives is then 69–80%, which is 8 to 16 points below the other-mined negatives, not significantly different from all pooled negatives, and 14 to 42 points above the self-mined ones. SugarCrepe discards negatives that a text-only model can reject [ 14 ] , which may contribute to their hardness. The two benchmarks also differ in the modality of the negatives, the number of relevant items per query and the assessor, so the contrast with SVO-Probes is an observation on two benchmarks and not an effect that we can attribute to one cause. One reason for the easy other-mined negatives is visible in Success@10. On COCO the positive is inside the top 10 for 53–89% and 78–95% of the pool queries, so few other-mined negatives can outrank it. All pooled negatives still lower every model below the random condition in both directions ( p < 0.01 p<0.01 in every cell), and ten other-mined negatives cost as much accuracy as 130 to 230 random images for caption queries and as 150 to 740 random captions for image queries. Because o3 misses a third of the correct items ( Section 6 ), correct items among its negatives could inflate the hardness of the mined conditions. On the 24 queries that the expert labelled, self-mined accuracy changes by 2.1 points on average in absolute terms (at most 7) with the expert’s labels, and self-mined negatives stay 6 to 46 points below other-mined ones for every model; this sample is too small to exclude the effect for the whole pool.

SugarCrepe的负数比其他负数更难, 并且位于所有负数的5分之内。 这些值超过了表1的探针精度,因为每个条件对最佳相关项目都给出了负分,而COCO图像有5个相关标题;在SVO-Probes上,大多数查询有一个相关项目,这两个规则在最多1.3分时就不同了. 根据探测器自己的规则, 手动底片的准确度是69-80%,比其他底片低8至16分,与所有集合底片没有显著区别,比自取底片高出14至42分. 糖类 Crepe丢弃了只有文本的模型可以拒绝的负数[14],这可能有助于它们的硬度. 这两个基准在负数的模式,每个查询的相关项目数量和评审员方面也有不同,因此与SVO-Probes的对比是两个基准上的观察,而不是我们可以归结于一个原因的效果. 其他容易忽略的负数的一个原因可见于成功@10. 在COCO中,正数在前10位,53-89%和78-95%的集合查询中,因此很少有其他的负数能排在前10位。 所有集合的负数仍然会降低双向随机条件以下的每个模型(每个单元格的p < 0.01 p < 0.01),另外10个被忽略的负数的精确度高达130到230个随机图像用于标题查询,还有150到740个图像查询的随机标题. 由于o3漏掉了1/3的正确项目(第6节),其负数中的正确项目可能会加剧所埋设条件的硬度。 在专家贴上标签的24个查询中,自我忽略的准确度在绝对值上平均变化了2.1分(最多为7分),自忽略的负数在每个模型中都低于其他忽略的6至46分;这一样本太小,无法排除对整个集合的影响.

blocks.en: Four checks address whether the pool or the scoring rule produces the difference between handcrafted and other-mined negatives. The first is label noise, because a mined negative that is in fact correct legitimately scores high. When the other-mined negatives of image queries are restricted to those that all three annotators marked incorrect (51–64% of them), the handcrafted negatives remain 4 to 8 points easier ( p < 0.05 p<0.05 for four models, p < 0.1 p<0.1 for BLIP-2 and FLAVA). When the negatives of both directions are restricted to those that o3 also labelled incorrect (81–90%), the difference is 6 to 9 points and significant in all twelve cells. The second is the two Qwen embedders, whose lists have one annotator: without the items that only they retrieved, the difference is 6 to 12 points ( p < 0.05 p<0.05 in all cells). The third is pool depth. With pools of depth 5 and depth 3 built from the same labels, the difference grows (8–15 points at depth 5 and 11–19 at depth 3, p < 0.01 p<0.01 in every cell), so it is largest for the highest-ranked retrievals and would probably shrink for pools deeper than 10. The fourth is the scoring rule of CLIP, FLAVA and SigLIP2. Cosine similarity raises their strict Success@1 for image queries from 5.6–13.4% to 10.0–16.4%, but on the same judged negatives the difference remains 6 to 11 points ( p < 0.05 p<0.05 in all six cells), and 3 to 9 points ( p < 0.05 p<0.05 in four cells) when the negatives inside their cosine top 10 are removed as well.

blocks.en: For the same queries we cross-tabulate whether the model scores the positive above all handcrafted negatives of the query, which we call passing the probe and which happens for 65–86% of the queries, and whether its top-ranked candidate is judged correct. The probe passes while retrieval fails on 14 to 22 caption queries and 8 to 33 image queries, and the opposite occurs on 13 to 21 and 11 to 24 queries. The top-ranked item is correct for 52–91% of the queries that pass the probe and for 53–86% of those that fail it, and Fisher’s exact test finds no association for any model after correction. With only 14 to 35 queries failing the probe the test would miss moderate effects, so we conclude that no association is detected, not that there is none.
blocks.zh: 对于同样的疑问,我们交叉计算模型是否将正数评分高于所有手工制作的查询底数,我们称之为通过探测器,65-86%的查询都会发生,其排名最高的候选人是否被判定正确。 探测器在14至22个字幕查询和8至33个图像查询中失败时通过,13至21个和11至24个查询中则出现相反的情况. 在通过探测器的52–91 % 和失败者53–86 % 中,排名最高的项目是正确的,费舍尔的精确测试发现在修正后没有任何模型关联. 由于只有14到35个询问 探测器失败了 测试会错过中度效应, 所以我们得出结论, 没有检测到关联, 没有。

blocks.en: Between 47% and 70% of the items in the judged top-10 lists are correct. Among the incorrect items, verb errors are the largest class for every model in both directions (39–53% of errors), object errors come second for most models (24–41%) and subject errors last (11–30%).

blocks.en: Every pool-based number in this subsection rests on the o3 labels validated in Section 6 , not on human labels. The retrieval numbers of the two Qwen models are in-domain here: Qwen2.5-VL-FT was adapted on COCO training pairs and the training mix of Qwen3-VL-Embed is likely to include COCO.
blocks.zh: 本分节中每个基于集合的编号都以第6节所验证的o3标签为主,而不是以人类标签为主. 两种Quen模型的检索编号是内域: Quen2.5-VL-FT被改编为COCO训练对,而Quen3-VL-Embed的训练组合可能包括COCO.

blocks.en: The pools also serve as a test set for the binary form of the probe, in which a model answers whether an image and a caption match and is scored by its accuracy on the benchmark’s balanced pairs (ITM accuracy). We re-ran four such decisions on every pool pair of both benchmarks: the matching heads of BLIP-2 and FLAVA, a yes/no prompt to the zero-shot Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct model, and a yes/no construction with Qwen3-VL-Embed ( Table 4 ; details in the repository). On the SVO-Probes pool the two heads reach 54–57%, against 62–63% on the benchmark pairs and 48–51% for a constant answer, and BLIP-2’s head answers “no match” for 77–87% of the human-verified correct retrievals. FLAVA’s head answers “no match” for practically every COCO pair, so its pool accuracy there is the share of incorrect pairs. The Qwen3-VL-Embed construction errs in the other direction and accepts 41–50% of the incorrect SVO-Probes pairs, and only the prompted model keeps balanced error rates on both pools. Balanced benchmark pairs thus hide one-sided decisions that the pools expose, which is an observation about these four decisions and not a general result.
blocks.zh: 水池还用作探测器二进制形式的测试集,其中一个模型解答一个图像和一个标题是否匹配,并根据其在基准平衡配对(ITM精度)上的精度而得分. 我们重新对两个基准的每对组合进行四项这样的决定:BLIP-2和FLAVA的相匹配头,对零射出Qwen2.5-VL-7B-指令模型的"是"/"不是"快",对Qwen3-VL-Embed的"是"/"没有"构建"(表4;存储库中的细节). 在SVO-Probes的集合上,两把头达到了54–57 %,而基准对齐的比分是62–63 %,恒定答案为48–51 %,而BLIP-2的头部对77–87 %的经人验证的正确检索给出了“不匹配”的回答. FLAVA的头部对几乎所有COCO配对都回答"没有匹配",因此它的集合精度是错配对的比例. Quen3-VL-Embed构造向另一个方向出错,接受41-50%不正确的SVO-Probes对,只有被激发的模型保持了两个池的平衡出错率. 因此,平衡的基准对子掩盖了集合披露的片面决定,这是对这四项决定的观察,而不是一般结果。

blocks.en: 6 LLM Assessors as a Substitute for Human Judgments
blocks.zh: 6名LLM评估员作为人类判决的替代

blocks.en: Human-judged pools are expensive, so we ask how well an LLM assessor approximates them. The assessors are validated on the SVO-Probes lists of the four dual encoders: the I → \rightarrow T lists, labelled by three annotators (4,000 list entries), and the T → \rightarrow I lists, labelled by the expert (4,000 entries). Between the three annotators, pairwise Cohen’s κ \kappa on the binary label is 0.64–0.68 and Fleiss’ κ \kappa is 0.64.
blocks.zh: 人类判断的游泳池很昂贵 所以我们问一个LLM评估员 如何接近它们 四个双重编码器的SVO-Probes清单对评估员进行验证:由三个注释员(4,000个清单条目)标记的I-\正线T清单和由专家(4,000个条目)标记的T-正线I清单。 在三个注释器之间,对等的Cohen在二进制标签上为0.64–0.68,Fleiss为0.64。

blocks.en: We prompted GPT-4o and the reasoning model o3 [ 29 ] (version o3-2025-04-16 , medium reasoning effort) with the query and its ten candidates and asked for a label per candidate ( correct or the error type). Table 5 reports agreement on the entries for which the assessor returned a parseable label; 1–4% of the entries are without one for o3 and 7–14% for GPT-4o. On the I → \rightarrow T half o3 agrees with the human majority on 82.6% of the entries (F1 0.84 on the correct class, Cohen’s κ \kappa 0.65); on the T → \rightarrow I half, against the expert, on 83.0% (F1 0.85, κ \kappa 0.66). GPT-4o is markedly worse, mostly because it misses correct candidates. Agreement with a majority vote overstates agreement with a person, so the comparison on equal terms is with single annotators: o3 reaches κ \kappa 0.57–0.61 against each of the three, slightly below the 0.64–0.68 that they reach with each other. On the lists of the two Qwen models, labelled by the expert alone, o3 reaches κ \kappa 0.60–0.68. Error types are harder ( κ \kappa 0.55–0.62 on the four-way label), with most confusion between verb and object errors. The assessor o3 is thus close to an additional annotator without being interchangeable with one [ 38 , 43 ] , and we use the human labels as ground truth for the SVO-Probes experiments.

blocks.en: The COCO pool of was labelled by o3 under the same prompt, one call per query over all pooled candidates: 200 calls, 6,554 of 6,562 pairs labelled, about 6 USD. The expert labelled 709 pairs of 12 queries per direction, drawn at random and shown blind to the retrieving models (last row of Table 5 ). o3 agrees with the expert on 88.8% of them, with κ \kappa 0.66 and a wide interval because the sample has 24 queries ( κ \kappa 0.55 for caption and 0.65 for image queries). It is more conservative here than on SVO-Probes: its precision on the correct class is 0.83, but it misses a third of the pairs that the expert accepts (recall 0.65). The COCO results of therefore rest on a stricter notion of correctness than the SVO-Probes results.
blocks.zh: COCO池由o3标注在同一快件下,每个查询所有集合候选人一次:200通电话,6 554通标注6 562对,约6美元。 该专家标注了709对每个方向的12个查询,随机抽取,显示对检索模型视而不见(表5最后一行)。 o3同意专家对其中88.8%的回答,有\kappa 0.66 和宽相间,因为样本有24个查询(\kappa 0.55作为标题,0.65作为图像查询). 这里比在SVO-Probes上更为保守:它在正确类上的精确度为0.83,但它错过了专家接受的对数的三分之一(回顾0.65). 因此,COCO的结果取决于比SVO-Probes结果更严格的正确性概念。

blocks.en: 7 Limitations and Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 限制和结论

blocks.en: Human judgments cover only SVO-Probes, and the T → \rightarrow I lists and all lists of the two Qwen models have a single annotator, who is one of the authors; the controls of Section 5 address label noise for the central comparison only. Every pool-based number on COCO is an o3 label, validated against 709 expert labels from 24 queries. The two benchmarks differ in more than the construction of their negatives, so the contrast between them is not causal evidence. BLIP-2 is evaluated in a reduced variant, and the two Qwen models are in-domain on COCO. The pools cover 100 queries per direction at depth 10, and the two directions use linked query samples and are not independent replications; they are a diagnostic sample and not reusable for models outside the pool: if the items that only one model contributed (29–62% of its top 10) were unjudged, its judged Success@1 would drop by 6 to 23 points. Six models are too few for conclusions about model rankings.
blocks.zh: 人类的判断只涵盖SVO-Probes,T →\rightarrow I列表和两个Quen模型的所有列表都有一个单一的注释者,他是作者之一;第5节的控制只为中央比较地址标签噪声. COCO上每个基于集合的编号都是O3标签,对来自24个查询的709个专家标签进行验证. 这两个基准的差别大于其负数的构造,因此它们之间的对比不是因果证据. BLIP-2在减量变体中被评价,而两个Quen模型在COCO上是内域. 池子在深度10时每个方向覆盖100个查询,两个方向使用连接的查询样本,不是独立的复制;它们是一个诊断样本,不能对池子外的模型重复使用:如果只有一个模型贡献的物品(其前10名的29-62%)没有得到判断,其判断的成功"1"会下降6到23分. 6个模型对于模型排名的结论太少.

blocks.en: We studied how image–text matching probes relate to retrieval by treating two probing benchmarks as retrieval tasks and comparing negatives of different origin under a fixed query, scoring function and decision rule. On SVO-Probes, judged-incorrect items retrieved by other models were significantly harder than the handcrafted negatives for all six models. This held under human labels, under labels on which all annotators or two assessors agree, and at every pool depth we examined, and ten such items reduced accuracy as much as two to four hundred random ones. On SugarCrepe the handcrafted negatives were the harder ones. A high probe accuracy therefore does not by itself tell how a model fares against the candidates that retrieval brings up; the relation has to be measured for each benchmark, and judged top-10 pools are sufficient to measure it. The strict retrieval metric understates the models, since most top-ranked items that it counts as errors are correct under human labels, and we detected no association between passing the probe for a query and retrieving a correct item first. For scaling such pools, the LLM assessor o3 came close to the agreement between human annotators without reaching it and was more conservative on COCO than on SVO-Probes, so an assessor should be validated on each benchmark and against individual annotators.
blocks.zh: 我们研究了图像-文本匹配探测器与检索的关系,将两个检测基准作为检索任务,并在固定查询、评分函数和决策规则下比较不同来源的负数。 在SVO-Probes上,其他模型检索到的判断不正确物品比所有6个模型的手动底片要难得多. 这在人类的标签下,在所有的注释者或两名评估者都同意的标签下,在我们检查的每个池深处,有10个这样的物品降低了精确度,多达2到400个随机的. 在"糖浆"上,手织的底片是最难的. 因此,一个高的探测精度本身并不能说明一个模型对检索所生成的考生有何影响;必须衡量每个基准的关系,判断的顶级10个集合足以衡量它。 严格的检索度量标准低估了模型,因为大多数被它算作错误的排名最高的项目在人类标签下是正确的,我们检测到在通过探测器查询和首先检索正确项目之间没有关联. 为了扩大这种集合,LLM评估员o3接近于人类注释员之间的协议而未达成,在COCO上比在SVO-Probes上更为保守,因此评估员应该在每个基准上和针对个别注释员进行验证.
